questions.question_text: Define a Relational Database Management System (RDBMS) and its structural framework. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: An RDBMS stores data in structured tables consisting of rows and columns, allowing users to link information between different tables using common fields like primary and foreign keys.

questions.question_text: Mention two basic emergency evacuation procedures that must be followed in an IT workplace. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Keep emergency exits clear of obstacles at all times, follow marked evacuation routes to designated assembly points, and never use elevators during a fire emergency to ensure safety.

questions.question_text: Briefly explain the core concept of transitioning to a Green Economy. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A Green Economy focuses on improving human well-being and social equity while significantly reducing carbon emissions, minimizing waste, and eliminating ecological scarcities through sustainable operational practices.

questions.question_text: State any two major functional responsibilities of an entrepreneur in a startup environment. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: An entrepreneur actively identifies market opportunities, secures and allocates necessary resources, manages financial risks, and innovates by introducing new products to meet evolving customer demands effectively.

questions.question_text: Write a basic SQL UPDATE statement to modify a student's grade in a database. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: To modify an existing record accurately, use this syntax: UPDATE Student_Records SET Grade = 'A' WHERE Student_ID = 101; This command ensures only the specific target record is altered.

sections.section_name: Section C - Short Answer Application Problems

questions.question_text: Write an SQL query to insert a new employee record into a table named 'Employees' with columns 'Emp_ID', 'Name', and 'Department'. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: The standard SQL syntax for adding this specific data is: INSERT INTO Employees (Emp_ID, Name, Department) VALUES (501, 'Rohan Sharma', 'IT'); This command precisely appends exactly one new row of structured data into the specified table columns.

questions.question_text: Describe the critical importance of workplace ergonomics in maintaining a healthy and secure professional environment. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: Ergonomics involves designing workstations to perfectly fit the user, actively reducing physical strain and preventing repetitive stress injuries. Proper posture and equipment alignment lead to higher sustained productivity, fewer medical leaves, and a safer, more comfortable daily working experience.

sections.section_name: Section D - Long Answer / Practical Scenarios and Troubleshooting

questions.question_text: A school library needs to track book issues using a 'Books' table and a 'Students' table. Explain why a 'Foreign Key' is essential in this specific relational database design and how it actively maintains data integrity. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: A foreign key in a 'Book_Issues' transaction table would securely link back to the primary key in the main 'Students' table, strictly ensuring that a book can only be issued to a valid, registered student. This vital constraint prevents orphan records, enforces referential integrity, and automatically blocks the accidental deletion of any student who currently holds borrowed library books.

questions.question_text: You are planning to launch a modern sustainable packaging business. Outline a brief entrepreneurial strategy that strongly incorporates green economy principles while simultaneously ensuring business viability and market competitiveness. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: The core strategy involves directly sourcing biodegradable, non-toxic materials to drastically reduce global plastic waste, perfectly aligning with green economy goals. Operationally, the business will minimize supply chain carbon emissions and aggressively market the eco-friendly aspect as our unique selling proposition. This appeals directly to environmentally conscious consumers, allowing for premium product pricing that ensures financial sustainability while protecting the planet.
